main_text.p: sunt, & pro dierum longitudine vel brevitate modò crescunt, modò decrescūt. Cujusmodi horæ inæquales ferè omnes intelliguntur, quæ in sacris literis & prophanis, ad annum Christi 3oo. usq;, aut circiter occurrunt:
Propriæ partes diei naturalis sunt pars Antemeridiana & Pomeridiana. Mane [?]Noctis sunt vigiliæ quatuor.
Annus naturalis est vel Solaris vel Lunaris.
Tropicus quadripartitas anni tempe-rat vicissitudines, quæ sunt Ver, & Æstas, Autumnus & Hyems.
VER est prima pars anni tropici ab Æquinoctio Arietis ad Solstitiū in Cancro numerata. Ver
ÆSTAS est ejus pars secunda à Solstitio Cancri ad Æquinoctium Librę numerata. Æstas
AUTUMNUS est hujus anni pars tertia ab Æquinoctio Librae ad Solstitium Capricorni. Autumnus
HYEMS est pars quarta à Solstitio Capricorni ad Æquinoctium Arietis, Hyems

page.notes: The right margin note at the level of "Propriæ" ("Mane") is faint and blurred; the reading is doubtful. The notes "Tropicus" and the faint marks near "Solaris" are too blurred to read and were left out. Show-through from the reverse page (faint text in the body and at the lower left) was ignored. The numeral "3oo" is copied as printed. The running head is printed in capitals with the period. The text of the notes ("Ver", "Æstas", "Autumnus", "Hyems") is taken from the small italic margin labels. The "Æstas" note is in italic and may be "AEstas" in the printer's spelling.
